name: v235_software_ip_capitalization_light_pure
hypothesis: Firms with lower capitalized software and patent/IP asset burdens may have cleaner reported asset bases and less future amortization drag, if the signal is not merely a lease/fixed-commitment sibling.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.35, 0.360 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capitalized_software_gross_value / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * gross_patents_ip_intangible_assets / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * patents_ip_amortization_total / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_software_useful_life, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Pure no-price version of the xAxWOnjq software/IP theme. Kill if weak, LSUS fails, or local corr maps back to 3q7PkXGN / lease-fixed-commitment / PPE-intangible actives.

name: v235_software_ip_burden_decline
hypothesis: Falling software and patent/IP capitalization intensity may be more incremental than low levels, separating disciplined technology capitalization from static asset-light exposure.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.35, 0.340 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(capitalized_software_gross_value / abs(assets), 252), 126), industry) + 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(gross_patents_ip_intangible_assets / abs(assets), 252), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * patents_ip_amortization_total / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / sales, 126), subindustry), -1)
notes: Decline/intensity variant with a small operating-margin confirmer. Kill on high corr to 78wrdZ6x, 3q7PkXGN, WjpR68WG, or ordinary quality actives.

name: v235_software_useful_life_conservative
hypothesis: Shorter reported software useful lives plus lower capitalized software intensity may proxy conservative capitalization policy rather than aggressive intangible accounting.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.35, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_software_useful_life, 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * minimum_useful_life_software_assets, 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capitalized_software_gross_value / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / sales, 126), subindustry), -1)
notes: Uses the low-alphaCount software useful-life fields. Kill if sparse coverage causes concentrated weight, LOW_TURNOVER, LSUS failure, or UNITS warnings.

name: v235_software_ip_capitalization_with_margin_no_reversal
hypothesis: Lower technology-intangible capitalization burden should matter more when core margins are already solid; this avoids price reversal and beta sleeves from the historical xAxWOnjq version.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.40, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * capitalized_software_gross_value / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * gross_patents_ip_intangible_assets / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * patents_ip_amortization_total / abs(assets), 126), industry) + 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / sales, 126), subindustry), -1)
notes: Margin-confirmed no-reversal version. Kill if it becomes a generic profitability/intangible sibling or if top daily-PnL corr is not comfortably below 0.68.
